an4.113:1.1: bhikkhave bhaddā assājānīyā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.113:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco bhaddo assājānīyo patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati.
an4.113:1.4: Kathan nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati. Kim assāhaṃ patikaromīti?
an4.113:1.5: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo assājānīyo hoti,
an4.113:1.6: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo bhaddo assājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ. 2.
an4.113:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo assājānīyo na h' eva kho patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati api ca kho lomavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati.
an4.113:2.2: Kathan nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati. Kim assāhaṃ patikaromīti?
an4.113:2.3: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo assājānīyo hoti,
an4.113:2.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo bhaddo assājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ. 3.
an4.113:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo assājānīyo na heva kho patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati na pi lomavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati api ca kho maṃsavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati.
an4.113:3.2: Kathan nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati. Kim assāhaṃ patikaromīti?
an4.113:3.3: Evarūpo bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo assājānīyo hoti,
an4.113:3.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo bhaddo assājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ. 4.
an4.113:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo assājanīyo na h' eva kho patodacchāyaṃ disva saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati na pi lomavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati na pi maṃsavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati api ca kho aṭṭhivedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati.
an4.113:4.2: Kathan nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati. Kim assāhaṃ patikaromīti.
an4.113:4.3: Evarūpo bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo assājānīyo hoti,
an4.113:4.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho bhaddo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an4.113:4.5: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro bhaddā assājānīyā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. 5.
an4.113:5.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave cattāro 'me bhaddā purisājāniyā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.113:5.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco bhaddo purisājānīyo suṇāti
an4.113:5.4: amukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthī vā puriso vā dukkhito vā kālakato vā ti,
an4.113:5.7: pahitatto kāyena c' eva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti paññāya ca ativijjha passati,
an4.113:5.8: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave bhaddo assājānīyo patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati,
an4.113:5.9: tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ bhaddaṃ purisājānīyaṃ vadāmi.
an4.113:5.10: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekācco bhaddo puggalo hoti,
an4.113:5.11: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo bhaddo purisājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ. 6.
an4.113:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo purisājānīyo na h' eva kho suṇāti
an4.113:6.2: amukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthī vā puriso vā dukkhito vā kālakato vā ti api ca kho sāmaṃ passati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā dukkhitaṃ vā kālakataṃ vā,
an4.113:6.5: pahitatto kāyena c' eva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti paññāya ca ativijjha passati,
an4.113:6.6: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave bhaddo assājānīyo lomavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati,
an4.113:6.8: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo purisājānīyo hoti,
an4.113:6.9: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo bhaddo purisājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ. 7.
an4.113:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo puggalo na h' eva kho suṇāti
an4.113:7.2: amukasmiṃ nāma . . . kālakato vā ti na pi sāmaṃ passati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā dukkhitaṃ vā kālakataṃ vā api ca khvassa ñātī vā sālohito vā dukkhito vā kālakato vā,
an4.113:7.5: pahitatto kāyena c' eva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti paññāya ca ativijjha passati,
an4.113:7.6: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave bhaddo assājānīyo maṃsavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati,
an4.113:7.7: tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ bhaddaṃ purisājānīyaṃ vadāmi.
an4.113:7.8: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo purisājānīyo hoti,
an4.113:7.9: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo bhaddo purisājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ. 8.
an4.113:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo puggalo na h' eva kho suṇāti
an4.113:8.2: amukasmiṃ nāma . . . kālakato vā ti na pi sāmaṃ passati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā dukkhitaṃ vā kālakataṃ vā na pi 'ssa ñātī vā sālohito vā dukkhito vā kālakato vā api ca kho sāmaṃ yeva phuṭṭho hoti sārīrikāhi vedanāhi dukkhāhi tippāhi kharāhi kaṭukāhi asātāhi amanāpāhi pāṇaharāhi,
an4.113:8.6: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave bhaddo assājānīyo aṭṭhivedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati,
an4.113:8.7: tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ bhaddaṃ purisājānīyaṃ vadāmi.
an4.113:8.8: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco bhaddo purisājānīyo hoti,
an4.113:8.9: ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho bhaddo purisājānīyo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
